summary: The independent review's central counterexample was reproduced: the candidate's complete six-test suite passes unchanged on the recorded base and at exact candidate commit 2e9ee6b921a55734331216fef05ff3390b9073ca. The tests are useful synthetic coverage but do not demonstrate a fix for the reported MiMo-V2.5-Pro-W8A8 ModelSlim/Ascend accuracy failure. No production change is justified without the checkpoint or Ascend environment, so the candidate coverage is preserved and the original issue remains unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: The exact six candidate test functions passed 6/6 against base production code before applying the candidate, confirming the absence of a failing-before regression.
The candidate's six synthetic fused-QKV mapping, scale-ordering, and configuration boundary tests passed at exact commit 2e9ee6b921a55734331216fef05ff3390b9073ca.
The reported Ascend tooling/runtime and checkpoint path are unavailable in the prepared environment.

gpu_execution.evidence: No GPU execution was used as evidence for this correction. Synthetic gfx950 arithmetic in the parent candidate/review cannot validate the unavailable Ascend/CANN load or serving path.

remaining_limitations: The MiMo-V2.5-Pro-W8A8 ModelSlim checkpoint is unavailable, so its real tensor names, shapes, ordering, and scale metadata were not independently inspected.
Ascend 910 hardware and CANN 9.1 are unavailable, so the reported NPU load and serving path was not executed.
The reported two-node TP32/DP4 topology is unavailable.
Generated-token equivalence and semantic accuracy for the reported checkpoint were not measured.
There is no issue-specific failing-before/passing-after regression; the preserved candidate tests pass both before and after the candidate.
No production or native source was changed, and no native rebuild was applicable.
